attested_features.quote: The roof was made of wood and the central nave, which led to the mihrab, had a higher ceiling than the two side naves.

scenes.title: Overview
scenes.caption: The building of the complex was begun in 1238 CE by Muhammad I Ibn al-Ahmar, the first Nasrid ruler and founder of the Emirate of Granada, the last Muslim state of al-Andalus.

scenes.title: Overview
scenes.caption: After the conclusion of the Christian Reconquista in 1492, the site became the Royal Court of Ferdinand and Isabella (where Christopher Columbus received royal endorsement for his expedition), and the palaces were partially altered.

scenes.title: Overview
scenes.caption: In 1526, Charles V commissioned a new Renaissance-style palace in direct juxtaposition with the Nasrid palaces.
